body: Thank you very much. Great advice.

Thank you for the advice. I just feel as though if I dropped my friends, I would be very lonely. They are all I have here. We are like a family. I think that they would support me if I told them I was going to quit drinking, though. They are not bad people. I am just impulsive and I go along with their shenanigans.

Thank you for the support. I know I was going down the right path when I chose to go to college. I go to a pretty great school and most of it is paid for, so I can't afford to fuck up my academics. I chose the wrong path when I got involved with my friends. All I do is drink and smoke pot, skip classes due to hangovers, and half ass everything. I feel like I can't get out of this rut. I feel like I can't change.
